hero.h1: Every mother deserves a safe journey.
hero.sub: MamaSafe helps community health workers spot danger early, keep every appointment, and act in time — from the first antenatal visit to the baby's first steps.

problem.h2: Too many mothers are lost to causes we can prevent.
problem.p1: Most maternal deaths are preventable. Yet danger signs — rising blood pressure, anaemia, a fever — are often missed when visits are skipped and records stay on paper. A mother who seems fine at one visit can be at risk by the next, and no one sees the trend.
problem.stat1_label: mothers die per 100,000 live births in Cameroon
problem.stat2_label: of global maternal deaths occur in sub-Saharan Africa
problem.stat3_label: antenatal visits recommended by WHO — many mothers never complete them
problem.progress_caption: Cameroon's maternal mortality ratio, 2017 → 2023. Progress is possible — and every prevented death begins with timely care.

what.h2: A companion that watches over every pregnancy.
what.p: MamaSafe is a maternal health platform for community health workers (CHWs). It turns a few simple measurements into an early-warning system: predicting risk, scheduling care, and making sure no mother falls through the cracks.
what.p1_d: Enter simple measurements — blood pressure, blood sugar, temperature, heart rate — and MamaSafe's machine-learning model estimates the mother's risk level in seconds, with a clear explanation of what drove it.
what.p2_d: The moment a pregnancy is registered, MamaSafe builds the full WHO 8-visit schedule automatically and reminds the mother on WhatsApp before every appointment.
what.p3_d: Risk is tracked across the whole pregnancy. When it rises, the CHW is alerted immediately and can refer the mother to the right facility — before it becomes an emergency.

how.h2: From first visit to first steps — six simple steps.
how.s1_d: The CHW records the pregnancy and last menstrual period. MamaSafe calculates the due date instantly.
how.s2_d: A short guided assessment produces a clear risk level — low, mid or high — with the reasons behind it.
how.s3_d: All 8 WHO antenatal visits are planned automatically, mapped to the right weeks of pregnancy.
how.s4_d: The mother receives WhatsApp reminders 48 hours and 2 hours before each visit. The CHW gets a daily list of who's due.
how.s5_d: Every assessment is plotted over time. If risk escalates between visits, the CHW is alerted the same day.
how.s6_d: High-risk mothers are referred to facilities, delivery is recorded, and care continues postnatally — for mother and baby.
how.timeline_h3: Tap a visit to see what happens

how.v26: Glucose screening, anaemia check, fundal height
how.v34: Presentation, birth plan review, danger signs

sim.p: Move the sliders. MamaSafe turns a handful of simple measurements into a risk signal a health worker can act on — in seconds.
sim.g_low: Routine care — keep the schedule and keep watching.
sim.g_mid: Closer follow-up — recheck soon and watch the trend.
sim.g_high: Act now — escalate and refer for clinical evaluation.
sim.disclaimer: Illustrative demo only. The real MamaSafe model is a validated machine-learning model that also explains which factors drove each prediction.

features.h2: Everything a health worker needs, in one place.
features.f1_d: Validated machine-learning model estimates maternal risk from simple measurements.
features.f2_d: SHAP charts show exactly which factors pushed each prediction — no black box.
features.f3_d: The full WHO 8-visit ANC schedule, calculated from LMP the moment a pregnancy is registered.
features.f4_d: Mothers are reminded before every visit; CHWs get a daily due-list each morning.
features.f5_d: Risk plotted across the pregnancy, with same-day escalation alerts when it rises.
features.f6_d: Refer high-risk mothers to the right facility and track every referral to completion.
features.f7_d: Postnatal visit tracking, PHQ-2 wellbeing screening, and infant growth monitoring.
features.f8_d: Districts, facilities and teams organised in one directory supervisors can actually use.
features.f9_d: Full English and French interface, on web and mobile — built for the field.

audiences.h2: Built for everyone who protects a mother.
audiences.a1_d: Your daily companion: guided assessments, automatic schedules, and a clear list of who needs you today — even on a basic phone.
audiences.a2_d: Gentle WhatsApp reminders, follow-up after every visit, and the reassurance that someone is watching over the whole journey.
audiences.a3_d: Real-time visibility across districts: risk trends, referral completion, and visit coverage — maternal health you can measure.

impact.h2: The trend that saves a life is rarely visible in a single visit.
impact.p1: A blood pressure that creeps up over three visits. A haemoglobin that quietly falls. On paper, each reading looks ordinary. Together, they are a warning — and catching it early is the difference between a routine referral and an emergency.
impact.p2: MamaSafe exists so that no warning goes unseen: every visit remembered, every risk explained, every mother followed — from her first appointment to her baby's first steps.
impact.quote: Every visit remembered. Every risk explained. Every mother followed.

cta.p: Join the health workers using MamaSafe to catch danger early and keep every mother on schedule.

mobile.p: Take MamaSafe with you wherever you go. The mobile app brings risk assessment, visit scheduling, and WhatsApp reminders to your phone — perfect for community health workers in the field.
mobile.f1_d: Built for basic smartphones and feature phones. No high-end device required.
mobile.f2_d: Record assessments and view patient data even without internet. Syncs when you're back online.
mobile.f3_d: Get WhatsApp reminders for upcoming visits and same-day alerts when a patient's risk escalates.
